title: 会话历史分组安全处理对象原型同名模型
goal: Fix ordinary SessionHistoryView grouping so model IDs constructor, toString and __proto__ cannot crash or pollute grouping. Preserve current group ordering, counts, model labels, search expansion/restoration, selection, transcript, polling and accessibility. Add rendered component regression tests covering these strings, repeated attempts per model, ordinary siblings, searching/clearing and polling additions. Use a safe dictionary or Map with consistent safe expansion state. Do not special-case sample IDs or model strings. Do not change existing regression tests, providers, IPC, stores, dependencies, configs or test infrastructure. Do not commit yourself: host verifies and commits with default identity.
nonGoals: No runtime acceptance hooks or environment overrides
No model CLI requests using reserved model names; these names are unit-test history inputs only
No unrelated UI redesign or identity/config changes
acceptanceCriteria: Actual rendered component handles constructor, toString and __proto__ model IDs with multiple attempts without throwing; normal siblings, ordering, labels and counts preserved; no prototype modification.
Collapse/expand works independently for these groups; active search exposes matches, clear restores preferences; selected attempt and transcript stable; polling addition remains safe.

Original tests unchanged; typecheck, complete frontend suite with maxWorkers=2, i18n, production build and isolation fence pass. Independent candidate checkout verifies exact source and changed-file scope.

Normal Tokage UI selects CODEX_CLI/gpt-6-luna for all model roles; Debug Provider off; actual model event, pipeline state/gates and normal UI merge recorded. If UI or key evidence unavailable record blocked, do not inject or manually certify autonomous delivery.
